scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter web --filter api --filter ai --filter @hr/contracts dev
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter @hr/contracts build && node packages/contracts/scripts/export-json-schemas.mjs && pnpm --filter ai exec uv run datamodel-codegen --input ../../packages/contracts/json-schema/api.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --disable-timestamp --use-annotated --field-constraints --enum-field-as-literal all --snake-case-field --allow-population-by-field-name --formatters ruff-format ruff-check --output contracts/generated.py
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter web --filter api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter ai typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter api test:e2e
